feedback:
Accept - concept works physically and is buildable as concept-stage design.

Working principle is sound: tri-star clusters rotating 120 deg per riser to lift load is established kinematics, load path handle/worm-axle -> cluster axle -> stair-nose reaction is continuous, no conservation violation. Self-locking worm + redundant pawl for hands-free hold is physically coherent. Energy model is correct: 60*9.81*0.17=100 J matches E12 100J. Everyday scale: 100J per step is ~lifting a shopping load one stair, human 100W can supply it. Torque 184 Nm E13 is plausible for ~735N total (60kg load + ~11-15kg device) on ~0.25m cluster arm. Direct pull 184/1.2=153N matches E30. With 15:1 and 0.25m crank ideal is 184/15/0.25=49N, claimed 98.1N E49 implies ~50% worm efficiency which is reasonable for self-locking worm and still <150N limit (~10kgf hand effort). Turns per step 15*(1/3)=5 matches E56. Structure: 60kg at 0.5m =294Nm E31, x2=588Nm E50, required S=588/240e6=2.45cm3 matches E52 for 6061-T6, twin tubes 2x1.44=2.88cm3 E53 gives 2.88/2.45=1.18 E60, stress 294/2.88e-6=102MPa E61 <240MPa. Pin 27.1MPa E59, mass 11.3kg E57 <15kg, van lift 88J E46 all plausible scales vs person/door/van.

Buildable: twin Al tubes, steel inserts, purchased worm gearbox, solid rubber 150mm wheels, straps, quick pins, hinges are all catalogue + cut/drill/fasten/assemble per steps 1-4. No exotic process.

Deviations noticed: 1) Direct 153N >150N ergonomic target - matters for unaided tri-star but mitigated by 15:1 to 98N, so not fatal to principle. 2) Twin-tube margin 1.18 over SF2 requirement is thin - matters for detail design/torsion/buckling but >1 so principle holds. 3) 5 crank turns per step = ~5s/step, ~60-75s/flight - matters for courier takt but not physics. 4) Pawl 6.13kN from 184Nm/0.03m E54 is large vs device weight - matters for tooth sizing but redundant with worm self-lock, detail task.

Claims resting on no cited source in solution (table has but not linked): wheel load capacity for 60kg+device (E40-E42 not cited), strap 800mm/250daN rating (E43-E45 not cited), self-locking worm catalogue basis (E7-E9 not cited in estimates), dead-man lever precedent (E27-E29 not cited), folded envelope 1200x600x300 proof (E39 sketch + E35-E36 van data not dimension-linked), pawl shear/wear life - explicitly open question with no calc, worm lead-angle/efficiency assumption behind 98N not shown, cluster/170mm riser/280mm tread interference not dimension-proved (E14 sketch not cited).

Meeting facts: closed by consensus after 4 cycles, v2 by Mara with ready votes from all 4 disciplines. Open O1 handle-effort overrun by Tomas is marked not blocking - i.e. team accepts worm mitigation. No unsettled proposal. This supports acceptance.

Remaining non-blocking detail work, not evidence_requests: compute pawl tooth bending/shear + wear, verify worm lead angle < friction angle and state efficiency, do interference sketch/simulation of 150mm wheels on 150-190mm riser/250-300mm tread, dimension-check 2-step fold envelope and crank-while-holding operating sequence.
